content.text: Show only what this character has met
content.help: The browser shows the quests in your journal, the places you found, the people you met, the things you held or saw in a chest, a shop or at a station, and what you could make. What you meet is kept all the time, switch it on or off whenever you like. Takes effect the next time the inventory opens.

TAKE gives you the item, as many as the box beside it says. KILL kills a unique person or creature, the ones the game keeps alive for its quests too, RESURRECT brings a dead one back. Takes effect the next time the inventory opens. HESOYAM typed into the game's console switches them on, typed again off.
